R. C. REC
No. 416
Date 30/6/16
Shanghai Municipal Council.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)
June 29th 1916

Sir,

There are at present a cruiser and three gun
boats in the Whangpoo river. These are stationed at
various points between the French Bund and the Arsenal.
It is reported that in accordance with an arrangement
between Admiral Lee Ting Sun 李鼎新 and General
Yang, all these ships will leave for Woosung to day.
It is reported that relations between Generals
Yang and Lu, Military Governor and Deputy Military
Governor of Shanghai respectively are very strained.
It is reported that eighty rebels have gone
on board the ships at Woosung and that an attack
on the forts is contemplated.

Your Obedient Servant,
McLaren
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

Entered on M.C.I June 29.

刑事侦缉处
收件登记
第 416 号
日期 1916年6月30日
上海工部局。
（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探分部）
1916年6月29日

先生：

目前黄浦江上有一艘巡洋舰和三艘炮艇。这些舰船停泊在法外滩与兵工厂之间的各个地点。据报，根据李鼎新海军上将和杨将军之间的一项安排，所有这些舰船将于今日前往吴淞。

据报，上海镇守使杨将军与副镇守使卢将军之间的关系非常紧张。

据报，已有八十名叛乱分子登上吴淞的舰船，并正谋划攻击炮台。

您忠实的仆人，
麦克拉伦
首席探长

警务处处长

1916年6月29日录入 M.C.I.
抄送上海工部局

Shanghai Municipal Council 30/6/16
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE JUNCTA JUVANT）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)
June 29th 1916

Sir,
The situation at Shanghai is becoming serious.
Admiral Lee Ting Sung who has declared that he does not
desire any fighting cannot control the personnel of
the fleet which he commands.
Both officers and men are being worked upon by the
Republicans who are endeavouring to bring about an
attack by the men-of-war on the Arsenal and on the
Woosung forts if General Yang at Loongwha and General
Lu at Woosung do not come over to their side which
is not at all likely.-
The Settlements may again expect to receive a
shelling if the gunboats in the upper part of the river
fire on the Arsenal and Lungwha.
It has always been from the gunboats that the
shells have come when on previous occasions they
have fallen into this and into the French Concession.

Your Obedient Servant,
[签名]
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

[手写批注]
Entered on M.S. June 29.
Copy to S.M.C.

上海工部局 1916年6月30日
（印：上海工部局警务处 协力同心）
警务处，
（侦探分部）
1916年6月29日

先生：

上海的局势正变得严峻。已声明不希望发生任何战斗的李鼎松（音译）海军上将无法控制他所指挥的舰队人员。

官兵正受到共和派的影响，后者正试图促使军舰攻击龙华的杨将军和吴淞的卢将军所辖的兵工厂及吴淞炮台，除非这两位将军倒向共和派一方，但这完全不太可能。

如果江上游的炮艇向兵工厂和龙华开火，租界可能再次遭受炮击。

以往炮弹落入本租界及法租界时，总是来自炮艇。

您忠实的仆人，
[签名]
首席探长

警务处处长

[手写批注]
1916年6月29日录入 M.S.
抄送上海工部局
